editorial:
Imagine living in a quiet town in Northern Finland where everything is peaceful until a giant mine opens up and turns life upside down. You get to follow Pepe, a woodcutter who is probably the most chill person you will ever meet. While everyone around him is stressing out or dealing with crazy bad luck, Pepe just smiles and rolls with the punches. It feels like a weird dream where things keep going wrong, but the main character just doesn't seem to mind. You will find yourself wondering if he knows something the rest of us don't, or if he is just naturally that happy despite the chaos.

The acting is great because it makes you feel like you are hanging out with real people in a strange situation. The movie takes its time, so it is not a fast ride, but the mystery keeps you interested. If you like stories that are a bit quirky and make you think about life, you will love this. It looks stunning, so you should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see the snowy landscapes. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a smart move because the colors are just beautiful.
endingExplained: In the end, you realize that Pepe's strange calmness comes from his unique way of accepting fate. After a series of losses and weird events, he doesn't fight against the world. Instead, he finds peace in the simple things. The story wraps up by showing that while you cannot control the big things like mines or accidents, you can control how you react to them. Pepe wins by simply refusing to be miserable.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves slow-burn stories and quirky characters.
